requirements.quote:
An endpoint sends a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame (Section 19.19) to
   terminate the connection immediately.  A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame
requirements.condition: When an endpoint terminates a connection immediately
requirements.why_checkable: A test can initiate an immediate termination and inspect whether the endpoint sends a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.

requirements.quote:
causes all streams to immediately become closed; open streams can be
   assumed to be implicitly reset.
requirements.condition: When a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame causes connection termination
requirements.required_behavior: Immediately transition every stream to closed and treat each open stream as implicitly reset.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave any stream open after the CONNECTION_CLOSE frame takes effect.
requirements.why_checkable: Stream states can be inspected immediately after processing connection closure.

requirements.why_checkable: A state-transition test can verify the endpoint state immediately after frame transmission.

requirements.quote:
enters the closing state; see Section 10.2.1.  After receiving a
   CONNECTION_CLOSE frame, endpoints enter the draining state; see
   Section 10.2.2.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-transition test can deliver the frame and inspect the resulting endpoint state.

requirements.quote: Violations of the protocol lead to an immediate close.
requirements.why_checkable: Malformed or prohibited protocol behavior can be injected and the resulting connection closure timing observed.

requirements.quote:
application requests that QUIC close the connection.  When QUIC
   consequently closes the connection, a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with an
   application-supplied error code will be used to signal closure to the
   peer.
requirements.condition: When QUIC closes the connection in response to an application request after the application has arranged closure
requirements.required_behavior: Send a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame containing the application-supplied error code to signal closure to the peer.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can request application-driven closure with a known error code and inspect the emitted frame type and code.

requirements.quote:
connections close cleanly and that delayed or reordered packets are
   properly discarded.  These states SHOULD persist for at least three
   times the current PTO interval as defined in [QUIC-RECOVERY].
requirements.condition: While an endpoint is in the closing or draining state
requirements.required_behavior: Keep the state active for at least three times the current PTO interval.
requirements.why_checkable: The duration of each state can be measured against the endpoint's current PTO interval.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints that have some alternative means to ensure that late-
   arriving packets do not induce a response, such as those that are
   able to close the UDP socket, MAY end these states earlier to allow
   for faster resource recovery.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint has an alternative means ensuring that late-arriving packets cannot induce a response
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may end the closing or draining state before three times the current PTO interval.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can configure the alternative suppression mechanism and observe whether early state termination occurs only under that condition.

requirements.quote:
for faster resource recovery.  Servers that retain an open socket for
   accepting new connections SHOULD NOT end the closing or draining
   state early.
requirements.condition: When a server retains an open socket to accept new connections
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not end the closing or draining state early.
requirements.why_checkable: A server with a retained listening socket can be observed to determine whether either state terminates before its normal minimum duration.

requirements.quote:
Once its closing or draining state ends, an endpoint SHOULD discard
   all connection state.  The endpoint MAY send a Stateless Reset in
requirements.condition: Once the endpoint's closing or draining state ends
requirements.required_behavior: Discard all state for the connection.
requirements.why_checkable: Implementation state or externally visible handling can be inspected after the closing or draining state terminates.

requirements.quote:
all connection state.  The endpoint MAY send a Stateless Reset in
   response to any further incoming packets belonging to this
   connection.
requirements.condition: When a packet belonging to the connection arrives after the closing or draining state has ended
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may send a Stateless Reset in response.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet can be delivered after state termination and the endpoint's response inspected for a Stateless Reset.
